name: JustFab
notes: 2026-10-29: live US store (United States and Canada selectors). Menus: Shoes (boots, pumps, flats), Clothing (Dresses, Tops, Pants & Leggings, Skirts, Jackets, Activewear, Swim), Bags & Accessories. Footer '© 2026 JustFab LLC or its Affiliates', so hq_country US.
Membership (homepage via WebFetch): VIP costs $49.95 per month with a VIP credit; skip the month between the 1st and 5th; cancel anytime; 'Your First Order - Up to 75% Off Sitewide' for VIPs.

Shipping & Returns page: VIP orders free to the 48 contiguous states at $70+ ($4.95 under); non-VIP free at $49+; Alaska/Hawaii $9, APO/FPO $9, Canada $9.95. Returns and exchanges 'within 60 days from the date of shipment', new and unused. Some dresses carry a $9 fee (wording cut off).
Dresses page (/shop/clothing/dresses) renders no prices to a plain fetch apart from a 'Dresses Sale - $20' banner, so no price row.
